subject: Teruaki Sato
title: Who is Teruaki Sato? Japan's Triple Crown slugger posted for MLB
answer: Teruaki Sato is a 27-year-old left-handed-hitting third baseman for Japan's Hanshin Tigers who won the 2026 Central League Triple Crown. He was posted for MLB teams on Nov. 2, 2026, and all 30 clubs can negotiate with him until 5 p.m. ET on Dec. 16, 2026.
body:
Sato batted .306 with 39 home runs and 106 RBIs in 2026 to win the Triple Crown. In 2025 he was the Central League MVP with 40 homers, 102 RBIs and a .924 OPS, and he won the NPB Golden Glove for defense. Over a six-year NPB career he has an .851 OPS, has hit at least 20 homers in five seasons and has played at least 120 games every year. He also has 262 NPB games in the outfield. He helped Hanshin win the 2023 Japan Series and played for Japan at the 2026 World Baseball Classic.

Because he is older than 25, Sato is not limited by international bonus-pool rules. The team that signs him pays Hanshin a release fee based on the size of his contract. Reporter Jon Heyman has linked the Mets, Yankees, Dodgers and Phillies to him. If he does not sign by Dec. 16, he returns to Hanshin for 2027.
in_the_news: Sato entered the MLB posting system on Nov. 2, 2026, together with pitchers Kaima Taira and Hiromi Itoh.

faq.q: What position does Teruaki Sato play?
faq.a: Mainly third base; he has also played 262 NPB games in the outfield.
He is 27 and will play the 2027 season at 28, according to MLB.com.

faq.q: When is Teruaki Sato's posting deadline?
faq.a: 5 p.m. ET on Dec. 16, 2026, the end of his 45-day window.
